question: Which Harappa lower-face arrangement distinctions survive face exchange and end reversal?
outcome: Nineteen readable pairs occupy 8 displayed states. Exchangeable lower faces give 4 groups with counts 4,3,5,7; adding common reversal gives 11 same-side and 8 opposite-side objects; separate reversals give 1 group. Three unresolved pairs produce whole-frame bounds 11–14 and 8–11. Seven main checks and 9 independently reconstructed-source checks pass.
challenge: Published drawing rows lack an explicit oriented prism-face and common-end map. A and D inventory and native-raster refinements needed independent source reconstruction.
remedy: Declared each conditional representation before calculation, retained unresolved objects, reconstructed source fields and direct form-specific partitions without calling the orbit implementation.
retry_when: Adjoining-face photographs or 3D records identify physical ends, face order, incision orientation and damaged regions.
